_description: Machine-checkable encoding of pipeline.md's 'Done when' column and the standing flags. The human prose in pipeline.md and council/roles.md stays the source of truth; when they change, this file changes in the same PR. Keys starting with underscore are ignored by the runner.
_invariant_types: present = pattern must match the body; absent = pattern must NOT match; count = pattern must match exactly 'count' times (or at least 'min'); first_h2 = the first '## ' heading must match the pattern (conclusions first, coordination rule 3).
